description: Minister of Lab our and Foreign Employment - Cancel the Extraordinary Gazette No.2381/35 of 25th April 2024, Payment for the workers in the Rubber Cultivation and Raw Rubber Processing Trade. Cancel the Extra Gazette No.2381/35 April 2024 Payment for the Workers in the Tea Growing and Manufacturing Trade.
reasoning: This gazette content involves the cancellation of a previous notification related to the Wages Boards Ordinance, which is a legal/regulatory instrument. The content focuses on the revocation of delegated powers under specific sections of the ordinance, making it primarily about regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes (though a minister is named, it's in the context of executing legal authority, not detailing portfolio responsibilities). This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory modifications.
